nodes.name: README.md
nodes.value:
# Git Metadata Repository

This ref stores structured metadata for the project at:

    /tmp/meta-demo-remote.git

It is managed by [git meta](https://git-meta.com/), which associates
key-value metadata with Git objects (commits, branches, paths, change-ids,
and project-wide settings) and synchronises them across repositories using
ordinary Git transports.

## How it works

Metadata lives locally in a SQLite database (`.git/git-meta.sqlite`) and is
serialized into Git trees and commits under `refs/meta/` for transport.
This remote stores the canonical history under `refs/meta/main`; the
`main` branch you may see at the repository root is unrelated and only exists
for browsing.

Other contributors do **not** clone this repository directly. Instead they
configure it as a metadata remote on top of their existing checkout:

```
git meta remote add /tmp/meta-demo-remote.git --name meta --namespace meta
git meta pull
```

After that, reading and writing metadata works against the project's normal
checkout:

```
git meta get commit:HEAD
git meta set commit:HEAD review:status approved
git meta push
```

## Important notes

- Metadata is exchanged on `refs/meta/main`, never on `refs/heads/main`.
- Never push directly to `refs/meta/main` -- always go through
  `git meta push`, which serializes local changes and resolves conflicts.
- This README only lives in the very first commit on `refs/meta/main`;
  later metadata commits replace the tip tree with the metadata layout.

steps.label: Shared start
steps.headline: One shared starting point.
steps.note: greeting = hey, set = {A}, list = [first]. Both users have this state.

steps.label: Both edit
steps.headline: Both users change their copies at the same time.
steps.note: Local: hello, +B, append third. Remote: hi, +C, append second.
steps.command: # Independent edits from a shared ancestor

steps.label: Keep local string
steps.headline: String: keep the local value, hello.
steps.note: Both changed greeting. Local wins this shared-ancestor merge.

steps.label: Combine set
steps.headline: Set: A, B, C. Shared A appears once.
steps.note: B comes from local; C comes from remote. No member is lost.

steps.label: Combine list
steps.headline: List: first, second, third. Both appends survive.
steps.note: Entry IDs order the list. Here the remote append happened first.

steps.label: FF-only: blocked
steps.headline: A direct push of L would lose remote commit R.
steps.note: FF-only refuses that move. The remote stays at R.

steps.label: FF-only: accepted
steps.headline: Write merged M after R. Now the push can advance.
steps.note: git meta push reconciles and retries: remote history becomes B → R → M.

steps.label: u1 commit A B
steps.description: User 1 writes C1. T1 lists k1 → A and k2 → B; both blobs enter storage.
steps.command:
git meta set path:demo k1 A
git meta set path:demo k2 B
git meta serialize
steps.detail: C1  tree T1  |  Δ k1 k2

steps.label: u1 commit +C +D
steps.description: C2 retains k1/k2 and adds k3 → C and k4 → D. Only C and D are new blobs.
steps.command:
git meta set path:demo k3 C
git meta set path:demo k4 D
git meta serialize
steps.detail: C2  parent C1  tree T2  |  Δ k3 k4

steps.label: u1 prune to C D
steps.description: Prune writes C3 and T3 with only C/D. Earlier commits, trees and blobs remain in history.
steps.detail: C3  parent C2  tree T3  |  0 new blobs

steps.label: u1 commit +E
steps.description: C4 adds k5 → E. Its tip tree T4 now contains three values: C, D and E.
steps.command:
git meta set path:demo k5 E
git meta serialize
steps.detail: C4  parent C3  tree T4  |  1 new blob: E

steps.label: u1 push
steps.description: Push copies all four commits, four trees and five blobs to the shared remote.
steps.detail: user1 to remote  |  4 commits + 4 trees + 5 blobs

steps.label: u2 clone
steps.description: User 2 clones all commit and tree history, without blobs.

steps.label: u2 hydrate C D E
steps.description: User 2 hydrates T4: only tip blobs C, D and E move over. A/B remain remote.
steps.command: git meta setup  # continuing: hydrate tip
steps.detail: hydrate T4  |  transfer 3 blobs: C + D + E

steps.label: u2 get: missing A
steps.description: Get finds k1 in local history, but A is missing. Its promisor entry points to the shared remote.
steps.detail: k1 -> A  |  missing blob; promisor fetch pending

steps.label: u2 fetch A
steps.description: The pending get fetches A and returns its value. B stays remote.
steps.command: git meta get path:demo k1  # continuing the same read
steps.detail: automatic promisor fetch  |  transfer exactly A

steps.label: u3 shallow clone
steps.description: User 3 clones depth 1: only C4, T4 and blobs C/D/E. Earlier history is unavailable locally.
steps.detail: shallow boundary at C4  |  1 commit + 1 tree + 3 blobs

steps.label: u3 get: no history
steps.description: User 3 cannot find k1: T4 has only k3/k4/k5, and earlier commits are outside the shallow history. No blob is fetched.
steps.detail: k1: not found in local history  |  deepen history to discover older keys
